scope: Publication source, prebuilt local reader and optional hosted adapter; no production mutation or paid model requests

skip_reasons: All-topic enumeration measured once on desktop

hosted_prefix_tests.command: pnpm --dir web exec playwright test --config playwright.hosted.config.ts
hosted_prefix_tests.initial_test_adjustment: The mobile header intentionally hides its status badge; the assertion now checks its text on both viewports and visibility on desktop.

warnings: Existing main bundle exceeds the Vite 500 kB chunk-size advisory; build succeeded.

data_acceptance.external_jsonschema: 10648 immutable versions validated against exported JSON Schemas

offline.reader_environment: Python standard library; launch this test with -S to exclude site packages
offline.network_policy: Outbound socket.connect denied except loopback; no OS firewall configuration changed
checked: shared topic links and scientist profiles

living_corrections.scope: Actual flagship records, isolated disposable corpus copy; no fabricated corrections or human reviews added to distributed corpus

browser_performance.first_view_definition: fresh automated Chrome page, bundled app loaded and five flagship controls visible
browser_performance.memory_method: ps RSS summed over the test Chromium process tree plus the local reader; shared pages may be counted more than once

documentation.visual_review: Local Markdown preview inspected in browser at desktop width and 390 px. Banner and reader screenshot loaded; no horizontal overflow observed. GitHub rendering was not published or tested.

relative_links.scope: All tracked Markdown links and HTML href/src paths

publication_hygiene.historical_browser_reports: Only private local path prefixes were redacted; test outcomes retained.
publication_hygiene.runtime_sources: Five reader modules and two hosting modules reconciled with deployed files.
publication_hygiene.excluded: Credentials, private server configuration, authoring caches, environments, node_modules, operational backups and later unpublished campaign records.
publication_hygiene.dependency_symlink: Local dependency symlink removed from the publication tree and excluded from its Git history.

distribution_verification: Archive SHA-256, extracted per-file checksums, actual-credential exclusion, standard-library startup under external-socket denial and rebuilt-database equality are recorded in the adjacent *-verification.json delivery receipt after packaging.
limitations: Machine screening is not qualified human review. Human audit has not been performed.
The corpus remains below expanded per-subject coverage targets.
This edition was built and executed on macOS. The current Linux production reader was inspected read-only; the new examples were not deployed there. Windows startup was not executed.
No new research evaluation or claims of improved alignment were produced.
